title: 主动变被动三步

examples.en: Tom broke the window. → The window was broken by Tom.
examples.zh: 汤姆打破了窗户。→ 窗户被汤姆打破了。

guess.question: 变被动的时候，原来的宾语 the window 去了哪里？

options.text: 提到前面，变成了新句子的主语
options.feedback: 对！被动句的主语就是原来被动作影响的那个（宾语）。
不对——它变成了新句子的主语，句子必须有主语。
不对——动词部分变成的是“be + 过去分词”。

rule.rule: 主动变被动三步：宾语提前当主语 → 动词改成 be + 过去分词 → 原主语放到 by 后面（可省略）
signals: 只有及物动词（带宾语的动词）才能变被动
rule.formula: 主语 + 动词 + 宾语 → 宾语 + be(随时态) + 过去分词 + (by 原主语)

anchors.en: Tom broke the window. → The window was broken by Tom.
anchors.zh: 汤姆打破了窗户。→ 窗户被汤姆打破了。

anchors.en: We clean the classroom every day. → The classroom is cleaned every day.
anchors.zh: 我们每天打扫教室。→ 教室每天被打扫。

trap.wrong: The window was broke by Tom.
trap.right: The window was broken by Tom.
trap.why: be 后面要接过去分词 broken，break 的过去分词不是过去式 broke。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——三步记法：宾语提前、动词变 be+done、原主语挂 by 后面（不重要的就省略）。

check.stem: 把 “He wrote the letter.” 改成被动语态。

options.text: The letter was written by him.
The letter was wrote by him.
options.distractor: be 后要接过去分词 written
提前的应该是宾语 the letter

check.explanation: 宾语 the letter 提前，动词变 was written，原主语放 by 后。

check.stem: 把 “They will finish the work.” 改成被动语态。

options.text: The work will finish by them.
The work will be finished by them.
The work will been finished by them.
options.distractor: will 后要接 be 原形

options.text: The work is finished by them.
options.distractor: 时态要与原句一致（将来时）

check.explanation: 原句是将来时，被动保持 will be finished。

options.text: The book was written by Lu Xun.
The book wrote by Lu Xun.
Lu Xun was written the book.
options.distractor: 被提前的应是宾语 the book

options.text: The book was wrote by Lu Xun.
options.distractor: be 后要接过去分词 written

check.explanation: 主动 Lu Xun wrote the book → 被动 The book was written by Lu Xun。
